Why Brooklyn Homeowners Choose Us

Brooklyn homes are unique — from classic brownstones and prewar apartments to modern condos. We understand the craftsmanship your space demands.

Expert Painting for Every Brooklyn Home Style

Brooklyn's architecture is as diverse as its neighborhoods. Whether you own a limestone brownstone in Brooklyn Heights, a converted loft in DUMBO, or a classic row house in Bay Ridge, our painters have the experience to handle the unique challenges each style presents.

We specialize in plaster wall repair, skim coating, and meticulous prep work — essential for Brooklyn's older buildings. Our team understands lead paint protocols, high-ceiling techniques, and the attention to detail that prewar homes demand.

Brooklyn Painting FAQs

Do you have an office in Brooklyn?

Yes! Gama Interior Painting of Brooklyn is located at 41 Schermerhorn St #1018, Brooklyn, NY 11201. We're a division of Gama Interior Painting, which has been serving Nassau County and Long Island for over 16 years.

How much does interior painting cost in Brooklyn?

Costs depend on room size, ceiling height, wall condition, and paint quality. Brooklyn brownstones and prewar buildings often need more prep work (plaster repair, skim coating) which factors into pricing. Most rooms range from $800-$1,200. We provide free, transparent on-site estimates with no surprises.

Can you work in co-ops and condos?

Absolutely. We're experienced working in Brooklyn co-ops and condos. We handle Certificate of Insurance (COI) requirements, coordinate with building management, schedule elevator use, and follow all building rules for contractor access.

Do you handle lead paint in older Brooklyn homes?

Yes, we're EPA Lead-Safe Certified. Many Brooklyn homes built before 1978 may contain lead paint. We follow all safety protocols to protect your family during renovation and painting projects.

What paint brands do you use?

We exclusively use Benjamin Moore and Sherwin-Williams — the industry's best. We recommend low-VOC options that are safe for families and pets while delivering beautiful, long-lasting color.

Do you also serve areas outside Brooklyn?

Yes! Our parent company, Gama Interior Painting, serves all of Nassau County, West Hempstead, and Long Island from our headquarters at 206 Mayfair Ave, West Hempstead, NY 11552.

Two Locations, One Standard of Excellence

Whether you're in Brooklyn or Nassau County, you get the same quality, the same team, and the same guarantee.
